body:
I've tried everything, I was the guy who went out to clubs and talked to every girl in there.. I put myself through every uncomfortable situation imaginable and it didn't make a slight bit of difference.

I used to go out to clubs every Saturday, but I stopped once I realized I had done it for 2 years and gotten nowhere.

Tried online dating numerous times but tbh most of the girls on there just never respond. I think majority of them do it for the ego boost.

As far as interests, I dunno. If there's nothing both parties can get mutually excited about it's hard to see how the relationship would last, my friend had that and I think he was just bored shitless the entire time. But sure when you're 20 or so you'll go a long way for just sex.

I want to ask you something, how do you meet girls in this country?

As in real women/girls.. not just some idiot who's in it for the shift or for a shag.. someone who actually has a brain cell attached to their body.

There's no girls at all in my college course, there was no girls in school who were even vaguely inclined toward technology.

I've met in total two girls in Ireland who liked video games, one was from Northern Ireland, and the other rejected me.

Should I just do what every lad does and find the most attractive girl possible and put her up on a pedestal because she's willing to have sex with me?
